{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ProxyServer where

import Data.Word
import Data.Bits
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.IORef
import Network.Socket hiding (recv, send)
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO)
import Control.Monad (when, forever, void)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Feature flags for the proxy
data ProxyConfig = ProxyConfig
  { enableCompression :: Bool
  , enableChunkedRelay :: Bool
  , maxChunkSize :: Word32
  , headerOverhead :: Word32
  , enableLargePackets :: Bool
  }

defaultConfig :: ProxyConfig
defaultConfig = ProxyConfig
  { enableCompression = True
  , enableChunkedRelay = True
  , maxChunkSize = 8192
  , headerOverhead = 64
  , enableLargePackets = True
  }

-- Global mutable config (set via admin interface)
{-# NOINLINE globalConfig #-}
globalConfig :: IORef ProxyConfig
globalConfig = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef defaultConfig

-- Compute the effective buffer allocation size
-- When large packets are enabled, we allow chunks up to maxChunkSize
-- The total allocation includes header overhead for framing
computeBufferSize :: ProxyConfig -> Word32
computeBufferSize cfg
  | enableLargePackets cfg && enableChunkedRelay cfg =
      let base = maxChunkSize cfg
          overhead = headerOverhead cfg
          -- Add overhead for chunked transfer framing
          total = base + overhead
      in min total 65535
  | enableChunkedRelay cfg =
      let base = min (maxChunkSize cfg) 1024
          overhead = headerOverhead cfg
      in min (base + overhead) 65535
  | otherwise = 512

-- Validate that a received packet fits within our allocated buffer
-- Returns True if the packet is safe to process
validatePacketSize :: Word32 -> ProxyConfig -> Bool
validatePacketSize packetLen cfg =
  let bufSize = computeBufferSize cfg
  in packetLen <= bufSize

-- Parse the length field from a proxy protocol header
-- Format: [2 bytes flags][2 bytes length][payload]
parseProxyHeader :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe (Word16, Word16, BS.ByteString)
parseProxyHeader bs
  | BS.length bs < 4 = Nothing
  | otherwise =
      let flags = (fromIntegral (BS.index bs 0) `shiftL` 8) .|. fromIntegral (BS.index bs 1) :: Word16
          len   = (fromIntegral (BS.index bs 2) `shiftL` 8) .|. fromIntegral (BS.index bs 3) :: Word16
          payload = BS.drop 4 bs
      in Just (flags, len, payload)

-- Core relay logic: read from client, validate, forward to upstream
relayPacket :: Socket -> Socket -> ProxyConfig -> IO ()
relayPacket clientSock upstreamSock cfg = do
  headerBytes <- recv clientSock 4
  case parseProxyHeader headerBytes of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just (flags, declaredLen, _) -> do
      -- Feature flag check: if compression flag (bit 0) is set,
      -- the declared length represents compressed size.
      -- Decompressed size could be up to 4x larger.
      let effectiveLen = if enableCompression cfg && (flags .&. 0x0001 /= 0)
                         then (fromIntegral declaredLen :: Word32) * 4
                         else fromIntegral declaredLen :: Word32
      -- Validate against our buffer allocation
      if validatePacketSize effectiveLen cfg
        then do
          payload <- recv clientSock (fromIntegral declaredLen)
          -- Forward the validated packet
          let outFrame = BS.concat [headerBytes, payload]
          sendAll upstreamSock outFrame
        else
          return () -- drop oversized packet

-- Admin interface to update feature flags at runtime
updateConfig :: Word32 -> Word32 -> Bool -> IO ()
updateConfig newMaxChunk newOverhead largePkts = do
  modifyIORef globalConfig $ \cfg -> cfg
    { maxChunkSize = min newMaxChunk 65535
    , headerOverhead = min newOverhead 256
    , enableLargePackets = largePkts
    }

-- Main proxy loop
proxyMain :: Socket -> Socket -> IO ()
proxyMain clientSock upstreamSock = forever $ do
  cfg <- readIORef globalConfig
  relayPacket clientSock upstreamSock cfg

-- Entry point for testing buffer computation
testBufferComputation :: Word32 -> Word32 -> Word32
testBufferComputation chunk overhead =
  let cfg = defaultConfig { maxChunkSize = chunk, headerOverhead = overhead }
  in computeBufferSize cfg
